headline: Exchange Outflow Narrows To 558.7 Million Dollars From 695.8 Million
narrative: Clean-asset outflow across 79 exchanges narrowed to 558.7 million dollars from 695.8 million dollars, equal to 0.2079 percent of the 268.8 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 427.4 million dollars, down from 649.5 million dollars, Bybit sent out 85.1 million dollars, and Crypto.com sent out 32.8 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 31.0 million dollars.
author: jordan
